presentation.manual_preparation: Use upstream’s ROM-free setup pack and your own Japanese original. Its supported launcher performs generation and compilation. Select that launcher or its prepared game executable; upstream or you manage replacement and player data. Portcove only registers and launches it. Existing Portcove-built installations retain their original contracts.
